hooks.name: Check UI script syntax
hooks.description: After Kiro saves a script under static/js, checks the syntax of every app script with node --check. The UI has no frontend build, so a syntax error would otherwise only show up as a page whose scripts silently stopped working. Skips itself when Node.js is not installed.

action.command: command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; fail=0; for f in src/main/resources/static/js/*.js; do out=$(node --check "$f" 2>&1) || { printf "Syntax error in %s. There is no frontend build to catch it, so the page would lose this script:\n%s\n" "$f" "$out" >&2; fail=1; }; done; exit $fail
